previous_evidence: 033: all-record recorded-mean target 93.067 to 91.015 and maximum target 100.393 to 98.112; positive-production weekday same-hour standardized means rise by 11.624 and 12.396 respectively.
question: How can the overall means decline while means in positive-production weekdays rise?
input: Original Jan-Aug valid records, four exhaustive observed strata from weekday/weekend x same-time production zero/positive, two fixed continuous prediction targets.
method: For each target, write period mean as sum of four stratum shares times stratum means. Split later-minus-earlier exactly into symmetric mix contribution and within-stratum mean contribution using two-period average shares and means. Report stratum denominators and contributions. No stratum is interpreted as an intervention.
decision: Use exact arithmetic to describe the reversal and identify which observed strata contribute. If decomposition fails to reconcile the whole mean, correct the calculation before interpretation. Physical cause remains unproven.
